mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quotation.transport_request (id, shipper_company_id, status, current_version_no, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{shipperCompanyId}, #{status}, #{currentVersionNo}, #{version})

INSERT INTO quotation.transport_request_version (transport_request_id, version_no, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, submitted_by, submitted_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{currentVersionNo}, #{originUnlocode}, #{destinationUnlocode}, #{submittedBy}, #{submittedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.shipper_company_id, r.status, r.current_version_no, r.version, v.origin_unlocode, v.destination_unlocode, v.submitted_by, v.submitted_at FROM quotation.transport_request r JOIN quotation.transport_request_version v ON v.transport_request_id = r.id AND v.version_no = r.current_version_no WHERE r.id = #{id}
